verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is the core interface. The docs say to 'describe what you want in plain language' and Claude Code will plan, write and verify the code, and the GitHub README says it handles routine tasks and git workflows 'all through natural language commands.' Concrete example prompts, such as implementing a JIRA issue and opening a PR, and @Claude mentions in Slack show plain-language commands in several surfaces. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence that natural-language commands are interpreted reliably, since some community reports describe poor results even though they don't contradict the interface itself.
